info.title: Collara API
info.description: Synthetic demo data only. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457).

get.description: Always 200; `status` is `unavailable` when the database is down, `degraded` when storage, ledger or the projection worker is. In UI_MOCK without a database only the mode is reported.

get.summary: Start OIDC login (302 to the identity provider)
OIDC redirect target: exchanges the code, rotates the session, redirects into the app

post.summary: End the session (and return the provider's end-session URL for OIDC sessions)

get.summary: The signed-in user, active organization, roles, mandates and navigation
get.description: Derived server-side from the session; organization or party values sent by the browser are ignored.

get.summary: Seeded synthetic demo personas (demo environment only)

post.summary: Start an isolated demo session as a seeded persona (demo environment only)

post.description: Stored before any notification. Email notification is not implemented yet, so the state stays RECEIVED. A non-empty honeypot field is discarded without storing.

get.summary: Verifier registry entries visible to the caller
get.description: Placeholder until the projection worker indexes the verifier registry: returns an empty list with header `x-collara-projection: not-indexed`.

post.summary: Authorize a private upload (new document or new version)

put.summary: Upload the file bytes into quarantine (raw body: application/pdf, image/jpeg or image/png; max 20 MB)

post.summary: Server-side SHA-256 and validation; promotes the bytes from quarantine to evidence storage

get.summary: Short-lived (60 s) download link, issued after a server-side access check
